description: "Chronicles of the Schönberg-Cotta Family" by Elizabeth Rundle Charles is a historical novel written in the late 19th century. The story centers around the experiences of the Schönberg-Cotta family during the Reformation, particularly through the eyes of Elsè, a young girl, and her elder brother Friedrich.
